documents.text: 第三章已经给出完整求交和精确比较。本集接着处理同一个位置上的多份输入。上集先找齐参与者、报告全部输入对。下集再维护右侧顺序。并解释没有端点提示的共点为何会被发现。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">第三章已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>出完整求交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>精确<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3 jiao 4">比较</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>本集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 1 zhe 5">接着</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 2 ge 4">同一个</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>多份输入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme>集先找<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>、报告全部输入对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>集再维护右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>顺序。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 3 shi 4">解释</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ti 2 shi 4">提示</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>共点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 he 2">为何</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>被<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1 xian 4">发现</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 本章仍要求非零输入不竖直。任意两份之间没有非零长度重叠。不同事件位置的横坐标各异。这是不同位置的限制。不妨碍多个端点集中在同一个点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">本章仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 1 qiu 2">要求</phoneme>非零输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shu 4 zhi 2">不竖直</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4">任</phoneme>意两份<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 jian 1">之间</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 du 4">长度</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 die 2">重叠</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>事件位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4">各</phoneme>异。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>限制。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>妨碍多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4">个</phoneme>端点集<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 2 ge 4">同一个</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在允许共端点、端点落在另一条线段内部、多条线段共点。也允许零长度点输入。共线但仅共享端点同样允许。重叠、同横坐标不同位置和竖直线段参与扫描。分别留给后续章节。这些不是完整算法的输入限制。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yun 2 xu 3">允许</phoneme>共端点、端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="luo 4">落</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ling 4 yi 4">另一</phoneme>条线段内部、多条线段共点。<break time="200ms"/>也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yun 2 xu 3">允许</phoneme>零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chang 2 du 4">长度</phoneme>点输入。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4 xian 4">共线</phoneme>但<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jin 3">仅</phoneme>共享端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>样<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yun 2 xu 3">允许</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 die 2">重叠</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>竖直线段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4">参与</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="sao 3 miao 2">扫描</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2">分别</phoneme>留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>后续章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2">节</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>些<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4">不是</phoneme>完整算法<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>输入限制。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 把共同端点叫作 P。横坐标和纵坐标都是四。蓝色输入 A 从横坐标零、纵坐标四到 P。它在这里结束。图是教学示意。不是真实执行轨迹。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>共<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiao 4 zuo 4">叫作</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>纵坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>是四。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lan 2 se 4">蓝色</phoneme>输入 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 从<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>零、纵坐标四到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>它在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>图是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jiao 4 xue 2">教学</phoneme>示意。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 shi 4">不是</phoneme>真实<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 xing 2">执行</phoneme>轨迹。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 橙色输入 B 从 P 到横坐标八、纵坐标八。在这里开始。图中横纵每格都是一个单位。O 是原点。箭头标出坐标正方向。两份输入都包含端点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cheng 2 se 4">橙色</phoneme>输入 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> 从 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>八、纵坐标八。<break time="200ms"/>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme>开始。<break time="400ms"/>图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zong 4">横纵</phoneme>每<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 4">一个</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1 wei 4">单位</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">O</say-as></lang> 是原点。<break time="200ms"/>箭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tou 2">头</phoneme>标出坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4 fang 1 xiang 4">正方向</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>两份输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>包含端点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: A 满足纵坐标等于四。横坐标从零到四。B 满足纵坐标等于横坐标。范围从四到八。引用第三章的完整求交结论。唯一候选点 P 通过两份闭范围检查。所以这一对的完整交集就是 P。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 满足纵坐标等于四。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>从零到四。<break time="200ms"/><lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> 满足纵坐标等于<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>范围从四到八。<break time="400ms"/>引用第三章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整求交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 yi 1">唯一</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hou 4 xuan 2 dian 3">候选点</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 1">通</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="guo 4">过</phoneme>两份闭范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 3 cha 2">检查</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 dui 4">一对</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整交集就是 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 紧靠 P 左侧只有 A。右侧只有 B。如果先忘掉结束的 A。再读取开始的 B。配对名单里就少了 A。会漏掉这一次端点接触。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">紧靠 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 左<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/>如果先忘掉<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 2">读</phoneme>取开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>配对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 dan 1">名单</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shao 3">少</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="le 5">了</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>漏掉<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>端点接触。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 先保留 A 在本次事件中的身份。把 B 也列进来。报告 A 与 B 的交集 P。然后 A 退出、B 继续。不再向右延伸。不等于不属于当前闭端点。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">先保留 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 在本次事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> 也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="lie 4 jin 4 lai 5">列进来</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>报告 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>交集 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/>然后 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 退出、<lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> 继续。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 zai 4">不再</phoneme>向右延伸。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 deng 3 yu 2">不等于</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 shu 3 yu 2">不属于</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>闭端点。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 这个理由不依赖两条线段的方向。只要一份闭线段在这里结束。它就仍包含这里的点。若还有其他参与者。就要在丢掉结束身份以前完成当前配对。这说的是数学依赖。不要求程序容器永远不能暂时取出成员。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>理由<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>依赖两条线段<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>方向。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>闭线段在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>它就仍包含<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2">还</phoneme>有<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">其</phoneme>他<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>在丢掉<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>以前完成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>配对。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1">说</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 4 xue 2">数学</phoneme>依赖。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 yao 1 qiu 2">不要求</phoneme>程序容器<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yong 2 yuan 3">永远</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能暂时取出成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 这次只取 B 和新的紫色输入 C。暂不取 A。C 从横坐标一、纵坐标七到横坐标九、纵坐标负一。满足纵坐标等于八减横坐标。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 qu 3">只取</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>新<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zi 3 se 4">紫色</phoneme>输入 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>暂<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>取 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/><lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> 从<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、纵坐标七到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>九、纵坐标负<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>满足纵坐标等于八减<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 用第三章的同一位置精确高度判断。C 在横坐标四处的高度是四。四又严格在一和九之间。所以 P 严格位于 C 内部。没有端点在 P。不代表不参加。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">用第三章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 1">同一</phoneme>位置精确高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pan 4 duan 4">判断</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> 在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 4">处</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>是四。<break time="400ms"/>四又严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>九<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 jian 1">之间</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme>位于 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> 内部。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有端点在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 dai 4 biao 3">不代表</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 jia 1">参加</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 起点清单直接给出 B。却没有把严格穿过的 C 当作端点列在这里。只用端点名单配对会漏掉 B 与 C。还要到旧活动顺序中找同高度成员。才能报告这一对对应 P。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2 dian 3">起点</phoneme>清<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1">单</phoneme>直接<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>出 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>却<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme>严<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 2">格</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chuan 1 guo 4">穿过</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 4 zuo 4">当作</phoneme>端点列在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>用端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 dan 1">名单</phoneme>配对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>漏掉 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hai 2">还</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme>到旧活动顺序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>找<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>才能报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 dui 4">一对</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dui 4 ying 4">对应</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 这里查的是仍覆盖事件横坐标的旧活动线段。再比较它们在这里的精确高度。若只是延长线经过 P。线段范围并未覆盖这里。就不能加入。点归属的共线和闭范围结论见第三章。不重做求交公式。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2">查</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>是仍覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>事件<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>旧活动线段。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bi 3 jiao 4">比较</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ta 1 men 5">它们</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>精确高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yan 2 chang 2">延长</phoneme>线<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1 guo 4">经过</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>线段范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>未覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能加入。<break time="400ms"/>点归<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shu 3">属</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gong 4 xian 4">共线</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>闭范围<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 4">见</phoneme>第三章。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 zuo 4">重做</phoneme>求交公式。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 这一页新增的机制是。端点让我们到站。旧活动顺序补齐没有端点提示的参与者。到达一个已知位置后怎样找齐。与这个位置为什么一定会被发现。是不同问题。后一个问题留给下集。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ye 4">一页</phoneme>新增<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>机制是。<break time="200ms"/>端点让<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wo 3 men 5">我们</phoneme>到站。<break time="200ms"/>旧活动顺序补<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ti 2 shi 4">提示</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>到达<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 4">一个</phoneme>已知位置后怎样找<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">齐</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 4 shen 2 me 5">为什么</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ding 4">一定</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>被<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1 xian 4">发现</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>问题。<break time="400ms"/>后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 4">一个</phoneme>问题留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>集。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在取回 A。和 B、C 一起。再加入绿色输入 D。D 从横坐标二、纵坐标零到横坐标七、纵坐标十。满足纵坐标等于二倍横坐标减四。只看 P 这次事件。不重演整次扫描。

documents.text: D 在横坐标四处的高度也是四。而且四严格在二和七之间。所以 D 也严格穿过 P。其他端点的横坐标是零、一、二、七、八、九。与四不同。也彼此不同。符合本章条件。

documents.text: 例如检查旧邻居 A 与 C。可以算出未来位置 P。这只说明要在 P 停下。到站后不能只处理这一对。A 的结束、B 的开始。以及 C、D 的穿过。都属于同一次事件。

documents.text: 引用第三章的同点结论。横坐标和纵坐标分别相等。才是同一精确位置。其他输入对再发现 P。就使用同一位置记录。不能因为来源不同。把同点拆成多次处理。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">引用第三章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>纵坐标<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2">分别</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 deng 3">相等</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>才是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 1">同一</phoneme>精确位置。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">其</phoneme>他输入对再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fa 1 xian 4">发现</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>就使用<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 1">同一</phoneme>位置记录。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yin 1 wei 4">因为</phoneme>来源<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点拆成多次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 所有端点预先已知。所以 P 的记录可以保留哪些输入从这里开始、哪些在这里结束。交点记录并入这个位置时。不能覆盖已有端点信息。后面还要加入点输入身份。

documents.text: 继续沿用第二章《扫描过程与三类事件》的规则。真实未来交点即使暂时失去邻接。也保留到取出。清单每次取最左的未处理位置。同一位置只统一处理一次。预约的一对提供发现依据。完整名单到站再找。

documents.text: 把同一个事件位置一般地写成 P。符号 x 下标 P 和 y 下标 P 分别表示它的横坐标和纵坐标。案例中都等于四。非零输入按横坐标认出左端点和右端点。不由端点书写顺序决定。下面的角色含义不依赖数值四。

documents.text: 经过 P 的非零输入。若左端点就是 P、右端点横坐标更大。就叫开始者。本例 B 是开始者。它参与当前报告。右侧也继续。但左侧旧顺序里还没有它。

documents.text: 若右端点就是 P、左端点横坐标更小。就叫结束者。本例 A 是结束者。在旧顺序中。也参与当前闭端点报告。只是右侧不再继续。

documents.text: 把紧靠 P 左侧的活动顺序叫旧顺序。其中经过 P 的旧参与者叫相遇块。它包括结束者和严格穿过者。不包括开始者。本例旧块是从下到上的 D、A、C。没有旧参与者时就是空块。

documents.text: 沿用第二章《为什么不会漏掉交点》的无事件区间。W 在紧邻 P 左侧不会提前结束。这次还允许它恰好在 P 结束。闭线段包含结束端点。所以到 P 仍存在。共同存在和左侧夹层的条件仍满足。

alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 jian 1">之间</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>旧成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shou 1 jin 4 lai 5">收进来</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>因此旧<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>连续成块。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能照搬<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4">任</phoneme>意两条交<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 1">叉</phoneme>前必<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 lin 2">相邻</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 沿用第二章的边界高度结论。把所有旧成员的高度都取在 x 下标 P。顺序仍从下到上不递减。允许相等。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">沿用第二章<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>边界高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 lun 4">结论</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 you 3">所有</phoneme>旧成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme>取在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>顺序仍从<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 di 4 jian 3">不递减</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yun 2 xu 3">允许</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 deng 3">相等</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在可以按精确高度。有序定位第一条不低于 y 下标 P 的旧成员。利用已经维护的顺序来找块首。不必每次遍历所有输入。这里说明查找用途。不展开容器代码。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 2 yi 3">可以</phoneme>按精确高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>有序定位<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="di 4 yi 1">第一</phoneme>条<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>低于 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>旧成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>利用已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme>维护<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>顺序来找块首。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 bi 4">不必</phoneme>每次遍历<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 you 3">所有</phoneme>输入。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="li 3">里</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1">说</phoneme>明<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="cha 2 zhao 3">查找</phoneme>用途。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>展开容器代码。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 若第一条等于 y 下标 P。就沿相等者逐条取出。直到遇见不相等者。若第一条已经更高。或根本没有不低于者。就没有相等块。只得到插入空隙。结束者也在旧块中。端点名单可核对其身份。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="di 4 yi 1">第一</phoneme>条等于 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Y</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>就沿<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 deng 2 zhe 3">相等者</phoneme>逐条取出。<break time="200ms"/>直到遇<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jian 4">见</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 deng 2 zhe 3">相等者</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="di 4 yi 1">第一</phoneme>条已<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jing 1">经</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme>高。<break time="200ms"/>或根本<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>低于者。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 deng 3">相等</phoneme>块。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2 dao 4">得到</phoneme>插入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 4 xi 4">空隙</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>者也在旧块<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 dan 1">名单</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 3">可</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">核</phoneme>对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">其</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 取得整个旧块后。再合并清单中从 P 开始的非零输入。本例由旧块 D、A、C 补入 B。得到四份参与者。结束者 A 仍保留到当前配对完成。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 3 de 2">取得</phoneme>整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4">个</phoneme>旧块后。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>清<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1">单</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>从 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 开始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>非零输入。<break time="400ms"/>本例由旧块 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">D</say-as></lang>、<lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>、<lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> 补入 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 2 dao 4">得到</phoneme>四份<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>者 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 仍保留到<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>配对完成。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 端点记录中也能读到 A 的结束身份。但 A 已在旧块中。不能再加一份。合并按原始编号去重。相同编号只留一次。不同编号即使同点也不能合并。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">端点记录<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>也能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 2">读</phoneme>到 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>但 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> 已在旧块<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能再加<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>按原始编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qu 4 chong 2">去重</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 tong 2">相同</phoneme>编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme>即使<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>点也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 任取一份包含 P 的非零非竖直输入。左端点若在 P 左边。它就在紧邻左侧活动。已由旧块收集。若左端点不在左边。只能恰好是 P。便在开始者名单中。这两路覆盖全部非零参与者。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4">任</phoneme>取<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 fen 4">一份</phoneme>包含 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>非零非竖直输入。<break time="200ms"/>左端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 左边。<break time="200ms"/>它就在紧邻左<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>活动。<break time="200ms"/>已由旧块收集。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme>左端点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 zai 4">不在</phoneme>左边。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qia 4 hao 3">恰好</phoneme>是 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bian 4">便</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kai 1 shi 2 zhe 3">开始者</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 dan 1">名单</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhong 1">中</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>两路覆<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gai 4">盖</phoneme>全部非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 反过来。旧块里的成员覆盖 x 下标 P 且精确等高。所以确实经过 P。块外成员高度不同。不经过 P。开始者则由真实端点给出。两路没有凭空加入旁观者。点输入稍后单列。当前论证只针对非零输入。

documents.text: 沿用第一章《逐对检查的基准方法》的无序对枚举结论。当前名单 A、B、C、D 对应图中的六个不同输入对。每对的交集都是 P。

documents.text: 六对只是数值案例。还需要对任意数量的参与者说明理由。每份参与者已经确认包含 P。所以任取两份。它们至少共享 P。不会报告一个不存在的交集。

documents.text: 引用第一章《我们究竟要求什么》的结论。两条闭线段若有两个不同公共点。就共享非零长度区间。本章不允许这种重叠。所以这两份的完整交集恰好只有 P。只要有点输入。也不可能出现第二个公共点。

documents.text: 跨事件也不会重复。本章每对非空交集只能是一个点。而同一精确位置只处理一次。这是已到达位置的完整报告理由。没有端点提示的共点为何一定被预约。到下集再证明。不能提前假定已经解决。

documents.text: 点输入只在横坐标等于 x 下标 P 时存在。任意更大的横坐标都没有它的点。所以配对后不进入右侧活动顺序。不给它安排在 C 上方或下方。也不用凭空指定直线或斜率。本例两侧都只有 C。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme>等于 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">X</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>标 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang> 时存在。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ren 4">任</phoneme>意<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="da 4">大</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="heng 2 zuo 4 biao 1">横坐标</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有它<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>点。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="suo 2 yi 3">所以</phoneme>配对后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 jin 4 ru 4">不进入</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>活动顺序。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="gei 3">给</phoneme>它安<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pai 2">排</phoneme>在 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shang 4">上</phoneme>方或<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xia 4">下</phoneme>方。<break time="200ms"/>也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 yong 4">不用</phoneme>凭<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kong 1">空</phoneme>指定直线或<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xie 2 lv 4">斜率</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>本例两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">C</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 若只取 Z 一、Z 二。没有非零线段。仍报告这一对对应 P。两侧活动顺序都为空。不能因为没有旧块或新块。就把当前点配对跳过去。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 qu 3">只取</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>、<lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> 二。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有非零线段。<break time="200ms"/>仍报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 dui 4">一对</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dui 4 ying 4">对应</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="400ms"/>两<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>活动顺序<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 kong 1">为空</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yin 1 wei 4">因为</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有旧块或新块。<break time="200ms"/>就<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>点配对<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tiao 4 guo 4 qu 5">跳过去</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 若只取 Z 一。当前只有一个原始身份。配不出不同输入对。结果为空。但这个已知端点事件仍正常处理完毕。没有结果。不等于没有事件。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 qu 3">只取</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ge 4">一个</phoneme>原始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="pei 4 bu 5 chu 1">配不出</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>输入对。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="wei 2 kong 1">为空</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>但<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4 ge 5">这个</phoneme>已知端点事件仍<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zheng 4">正</phoneme>常<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme>完毕。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 guo 3">结果</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4 deng 3 yu 2">不等于</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有事件。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 点恰好落在闭端点也一样。先单独取 A 与 Z 一。报告这一对对应 P。然后 A 结束。点输入不进入右侧。这一案例右侧没有活动成员。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qia 4 hao 3">恰好</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="luo 4">落</phoneme>在闭端点也<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 yang 4">一样</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>先<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1 du 2">单独</phoneme>取 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 dui 4">一对</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dui 4 ying 4">对应</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/>然后 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 jin 4 ru 4">不进入</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 an 4 li 4">一案例</phoneme>右<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ce 4">侧</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="mei 2">没</phoneme>有活动成<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yuan 2">员</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 再单独取 B 与 Z 一。先报告当前配对。然后只有 B 向右继续。这是另一个两输入案例。与左图分别处理。不能把 A、B 和两份画出的 Z 一 误拼成四个身份。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dan 1 du 2">单独</phoneme>取 <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>先报告<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>配对。<break time="200ms"/>然后<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> 向右继续。<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme>是<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ling 4 yi 2 ge 4">另一个</phoneme>两输入案例。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>左图<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2">分别</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>能<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ba 3">把</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">A</say-as></lang>、<lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">B</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>两份画出<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">Z</say-as></lang> <phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 1">一</phoneme> 误拼成四<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4">个</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 更多同位置点输入时。每份都分别与每条非零参与者配对。点身份之间也按原始编号配对。点只有 P。不会带来另一个交点。保留不同身份、同一编号一次的规则。让先前的不漏、不多报、不重复理由继续成立。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural"><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="geng 4">更</phoneme>多<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme>位置点输入时。<break time="200ms"/>每份<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dou 1">都</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="fen 1 bie 2">分别</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 3">与</phoneme>每条非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 yu 4 zhe 3">参与者</phoneme>配对。<break time="200ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 1 jian 1">之间</phoneme>也按原始编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme>配对。<break time="400ms"/>点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 2 you 3">只有</phoneme> <lang xml:lang="en-US"><say-as interpret-as="characters">P</say-as></lang>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 hui 4">不会</phoneme>带来<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ling 4 yi 2 ge 4">另一个</phoneme>交点。<break time="200ms"/>保留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2">同</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="tong 2 yi 1">同一</phoneme>编<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hao 4">号</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>规则。<break time="200ms"/>让先前<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 2 lou 4">不漏</phoneme>、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>多报、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 fu 4">重复</phoneme>理由继续成立。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 现在可以说清当前位置的完整名单从哪里来。精确高度找到旧相遇块。补入非零开始者。再合并点输入。按原始身份各留一次。结束者先参加闭端点报告。点输入只参加这一次。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">现在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ke 2 yi 3">可以</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1">说</phoneme>清<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="dang 1 qian 2">当前</phoneme>位置<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme>完整<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ming 2 dan 1">名单</phoneme>从<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 2 li 3">哪里</phoneme>来。<break time="200ms"/>精确高<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="du 4">度</phoneme>找到旧<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 yu 4">相遇</phoneme>块。<break time="200ms"/>补入非零<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kai 1 shi 2 zhe 3">开始者</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/>再<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">合</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bing 4">并</phoneme>点输入。<break time="400ms"/>按原始<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ge 4">各</phoneme>留<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="jie 2 shu 4">结束</phoneme>者先<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 jia 1">参加</phoneme>闭端点报告。<break time="200ms"/>点输入<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="can 1 jia 1">参加</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhe 4">这</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 ci 4">一次</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 先停一下。若只处理预约交点的那一对。会在哪一步漏掉其他身份？试着用旧相遇块、开始者和点输入三路说明。不需要重演整次扫描。
documents.ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="zh-CN"><voice name="zh-CN-Xiaoxiao:DragonHDFlashLatestNeural">先停<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 xia 4">一下</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="ruo 4">若</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="zhi 3">只</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chu 2 li 3">处理</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yu 4 yue 1">预约</phoneme>交点<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="de 5">的</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 4">那</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 dui 4">一对</phoneme>。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="hui 4">会</phoneme>在<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="na 3">哪</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yi 2 bu 4">一步</phoneme>漏掉<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="qi 2">其</phoneme>他<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shen 1 fen 4">身份</phoneme>？<break time="400ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shi 4 zhe 5">试着</phoneme>用旧<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="xiang 1 yu 4">相遇</phoneme>块、<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="kai 1 shi 2 zhe 3">开始者</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="he 2">和</phoneme>点输入三路<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="shuo 1">说</phoneme>明。<break time="200ms"/><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="bu 4">不</phoneme>需<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="yao 4">要</phoneme><phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="chong 2 yan 3">重演</phoneme>整次<phoneme alphabet="sapi" ph="sao 3 miao 2">扫描</phoneme>。<break time="400ms"/></voice></speak>

documents.text: 本集已经解释到站后怎样找齐并完整报告。接下来还要筛选继续成员、排出整个右侧块、检查新增邻接。没有端点提示的共点为何一定能到站。也留给第四章下集。到这里。不把当前位置的完整处理当作整次扫描已经证明。
